name: College Station
summary: Published storage prices near Texas A&M, only for places with a public page we could open. Triangle Storage in Bryan is included because students ask about it and it is on Old College Road.
regionNote: Older posts say Downing Road and All Seasons. The pages we could open say Dowling Road Storage. The Earl Rudder address tied to All Seasons is now a SpareBox page. Those name gaps are marked in the tables.
